blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – A 51-year-old farmer sustained a head injury after he was allegedly struck by another farmer with the assault victim’s bolo on Monday. The altercation began after the 51-year-old farmer confronted the suspect, a 67-year-old farmer, whose employee had mistakenly harvested a part of the victim’s rice crop, police said.
